strings.zh: 哟！你是今天{NEWLINE}最后一位客人哦！{SCROLL}
strings.en: OK!{NEWLINE}You must be the last passenger.{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 你想干什么？{NEWLINE}今天不出航！
strings.en: What do you want?{NEWLINE}We’re not sailing today!
strings.notes: US 0256/1 | tone review: 你想干什么？今天不出航！ is a curt brush-off; US line replaced to match the Chinese tone

strings.zh: 如若这次旅行后,{NEWLINE}我能活着归来,再度踏上{CLEAR}浅葱的土地的话,{CLEAR}请和我一起生活吧！{SCROLL}嗯？好不好？
strings.en: If I make it back alive from this{NEWLINE}journey and set foot in Olivine City{CLEAR}again, will you live there with me?{SCROLL}Well? How about it?
strings.notes: US 0256/2 | tone review: 活着归来 = come back alive; US 'safely' dropped the death stakes #3 mocks. Retranslated from the Chinese (再度踏上 = set foot again; 嗯？好不好？ = 'Well? How about it?')

strings.zh: 他的话,虽然是{NEWLINE}游览船的乘务员,{CLEAR}说话却常夸大其实呢。{SCROLL}
strings.en: He’s only a crewman of a{NEWLINE}pleasure cruise.{CLEAR}He has a way of exaggerating things.{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 娜姿『偶尔也会想看看……{NEWLINE}大海呢……{SCROLL}对了,和你交换电话号码,{CLEAR}似乎挺有趣的呢……{SCROLL}试着交换看看吧？{VAR:0200:0}
strings.en: Sabrina: Out of the blue...{NEWLINE}I get the urge to see the ocean...{SCROLL}It may be fun to exchange numbers{NEWLINE}with you...{SCROLL}Do you want mine? {VAR:0200:0}

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}把娜姿登陆到{NEWLINE}了手机中！
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0} registered Sabrina{NEWLINE}in the Pokégear!

strings.zh: 娜姿『星期日的白天{NEWLINE}接到我电话的话,{CLEAR}那说明我将和你{CLEAR}有一个非常重要的约定……
strings.en: Sabrina: If you call me on a Sunday{NEWLINE}during the day, you and I will{CLEAR}have a very important appointment...
strings.notes: US 0256/6; ext-review B-005 | D-1359 (D-1496/D-1572, approved by the user 2026-10-06): zh has her calling you; her own phone line 0646#4 (zh 到时候你能打个电话过来吗) and US 0256#6 have you calling her.

strings.zh: 娜姿『这样……{NEWLINE}我还以为可以和你{CLEAR}成为好朋友的……
strings.en: Sabrina: I see...{NEWLINE}I thought you’d make a good friend.

strings.zh: 娜姿『你想知道{NEWLINE}我的电话号码了吗？{SCROLL}我可是{NEWLINE}知道你内心所想的事哦……{VAR:0200:0}
strings.en: Sabrina: Now you want to know{NEWLINE}my number?{CLEAR}I can see it in your eyes... {VAR:0200:0}

strings.zh: 娜姿『嗯？{NEWLINE}{VAR:0103:0}你也喜欢坐船航行吗？{CLEAR}是不是觉得吹着海风很舒服呀。{CLEAR}不如咱们就在这舒服的海风里,{CLEAR}一起照张相如何？{VAR:0200:0}
strings.en: Sabrina: Hm? You like sailing too,{NEWLINE}{VAR:0103:0}? The sea breeze feels nice,{CLEAR}doesn’t it?{SCROLL}Why don’t we take a photo together in{NEWLINE}this lovely breeze?{VAR:0200:0}

strings.zh: 娜姿『那~要照咯！{SCROLL}
strings.en: Sabrina: Are you ready?{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 娜姿『哎呀呀,照得很漂亮嘛！
strings.en: Sabrina: My, what a lovely photo!

strings.zh: 娜姿『呵哦？{NEWLINE}这就开始摆起冠军的架子来了？
strings.en: Sabrina: Oh ho? Putting on Champion airs{NEWLINE}already?

strings.zh: 相册似乎满了。{SCROLL}请用电脑整理一下{NEWLINE}相册中的照片。
strings.en: Your album seems to be full.{SCROLL}Please use a PC to sort out the photos{NEWLINE}in your album.

strings.zh: 您好,欢迎乘坐新圣安努号游轮。{NEWLINE}请问您想的目的地是？{SCROLL}
strings.en: Hello, and welcome aboard the new{NEWLINE}S.S. Anne. Where would you like to go?{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 枯叶市
strings.en: Vermilion City

strings.zh: 水都群岛
strings.en: Alto Mare Islands

strings.zh: 我等会儿再来
strings.en: I’ll come back later

strings.zh: 好的,目的地枯叶市,请您登船！
strings.en: Very well. Destination: Vermilion City.{NEWLINE}Please board!

strings.zh: 好的,目的地水都群岛,请您登船！
strings.en: Very well. Destination: the Alto Mare{NEWLINE}Islands. Please board!
